label: Create Content
description: Creates new content of the type the request names inside the item this request is about. Later steps act on the new content. The type must be one listed here that the item can hold.

nameFrom.label: Name taken from
nameFrom.description: The fields of the request the new content is named after. If multiple, the first one holding text is used. If there is no provided text it is named after its type.

namePattern.label: Name pattern
namePattern.description: A pattern (regular expression) that a requested name must match. Left blank, any valid name is allowed.

nameHint.label: Name hint
nameHint.description: A description of what the pattern allows.

types.label: Type
types.description: The types of content that may be created.

nodeType.label: Node type
nodeType.description: The type of content created, e.g. "sch:Section".

label.label: Label
label.description: The label of the type. Left blank, the node type.

named.label: Named
named.description: Whether a request may ask for a name for the created item. Default true.

namePattern.label: Name pattern
namePattern.description: A pattern that the requested name must follow.

nameHint.label: Name hint
nameHint.description: A description of what the pattern allows.
